title: Workflow V2 Foundation
businessObjective: Establish the smallest safe contract for authoring and executing future V2 tasks without activating reconciliation or validator-registry automation.
technicalObjective: Add the closed Task Packet V2 schema, preserve V1 validation, make stage-specific routingPolicy the only V2 agent/route/effort authority, enforce agent and task safety gates, and persist launcher-bound structured SHA-bound review results.
assumptions: The existing hardcoded CI validator list remains authoritative.
Reconciliation and declarative validator-registry activation are separate future tasks.
No production or GitHub write behavior is in scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Task Packet V2 is a closed schema with stage-specific routingPolicy, explicit routingComplexity, and no top-level V2 route or effort authority.
The task validator accepts valid V1 packets and valid V2 packets while rejecting malformed or unsupported versions.
The launcher selects V2 route and reasoning effort only from routingPolicy.<stage>, rejects CLI overrides, and requires explicit high-complexity routing for luna/max or sol/xhigh.
The launcher enforces declared agent routes and reasoning-effort limits, rejects inactive agents, and rejects terminal tasks.

Review-result validation requires structured task, base SHA, head SHA, reviewer, model, effort, context hash, launcher run/trace, output hash, decision, and findings fields; the launcher creates the identity envelope and persists validated stage results.

A deterministic lifecycle fixture authorizes implementation and all three independent review stages, permits only same-task stage artifacts between reviews, persists their exact-SHA artifacts, and rejects verified until every configured passing artifact binds the review head.
Required deterministic tests and independent review cover the exact final Foundation diff.
